items.title: Java4Shell in OpenJDK
items.summary: A flaw in the optimised Base64 decoder affects certain Java builds on x86-64 processors with AVX-512 VBMI. Identify the runtime distribution, full build and processor before deciding whether a deployment needs updating.

https://access.redhat.com/security/vulne.summary: Red Hat identifies a possible service crash or remote code execution when untrusted data reaches the affected decoder. It describes the CPU prerequisite and distinguishes ARM64 systems.

https://adoptium.net/news/2026/11/temuri.summary: Temurin lists fixed builds 17.0.21.1+2, 21.0.13.1+2, 25.0.5.1+2 and 27.0.1.1+4. Its JDK 8 and 11 builds are unaffected. The vendor also documents a temporary workaround.

https://linux.oracle.com/errata/ELSA-202.summary: Oracle issued a Java 21 OpenJDK package update for Oracle Linux 8 and 9. Use the erratum matching the installed distribution and package.

items.title: WFX Phantom in GitHub Actions
items.summary: Two research teams describe stolen credentials being used to alter repositories and expose CI secrets. Review workflow history and the permissions of any credentials available to an affected job.

https://www.stepsecurity.io/blog/wfx-pha.summary: StepSecurity distinguishes an initial probe pull request from an executed workflow. That distinction matters when assessing whether a secret was exposed.

https://www.endorlabs.com/learn/github-a.summary: Endor Labs updated its investigation of affected repositories and package changes. Its findings extend the review to downstream package consumers.

items.title: Node2Shell: Brotli decoder memory corruption
items.summary: Malformed Brotli data can corrupt process memory when a vulnerable application decompresses it. Node.js released fixes for the supported 22, 24 and 26 release lines.

https://nodejs.org/en/blog/vulnerability.summary: Vendor fixes released for the supported 22, 24 and 26 branches.

https://www.imperva.com/blog/node2shell-.summary: Imperva describes request and external-response attack paths and researcher-demonstrated code execution.

https://www.php.net/archive/2026.php.summary: PHP reports updated Windows packages containing Brotli 1.2.1, exposing a related dependency investigation path.

items.title: PHP2Shell: stale state across requests
items.summary: Request-owned PHP state can outlive its backing memory. A later request in the same worker can use that stale state before normal initialisation resets it.

https://www.php.net/archive/2026.php.summary: PHP distinguishes full remediation by update from partial configuration measures.

items.title: PHP2Shell: out-of-memory request corruption
items.summary: PHP request initialisation and cleanup can mishandle partially initialised data after an out-of-memory interruption. The vendor describes a risk of unauthenticated remote code execution.
